figures.caption: Placement $(-2,1)$ leaves twelve visible cells, eight of them opaque.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at blit return for placement minus two, one. Signed return values are eight copied and twelve visible cells. The complete sixteen-by-eight physical display begins with a gray guard; the logical image begins at physical column one. A three-column by four-row source slice is visible. A memory detail shows logical row one beginning at 0x10010044, with unchanged background, green and unchanged background.

figures.caption: Placement $(0,0)$ examines all twenty sprite cells and copies thirteen full-word opaque pixels.
figures.alt: Four annotated details after an unclipped five-by-four sprite copy. Return values are thirteen copied and twenty visible. The physical display starts with a guard before the eight-by-six logical framebuffer. A displayed magenta pixel is opaque because its stored word is 01ff00ff, which differs from the transparent key 00ff00ff. A memory detail at 0x10010050 shows bytes ff 00 ff 01.

figures.caption: Placement $(6,-2)$ clips the top two source rows and the columns beyond the right edge.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at placement six, minus two. Return values are two copied and four visible. Only source columns zero and one from rows two and three remain visible at logical destination columns six and seven, rows zero and one. White appears at logical seven, zero and red at six, one. A memory detail retains the leading gray guard and background through logical column six; the white logical cell seven is visible in the Bitmap view.

figures.caption: Placement $(-1,4)$ leaves an eight-cell intersection along the bottom-left edge.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at placement minus one, four. Return values are six copied and eight visible. Source columns one through four from rows zero and one map to destination columns zero through three and rows four and five. The physical display retains padding. A memory detail shows logical row four at 0x10010104 with red, background, green and background.
